statement: WITH batch AS (SELECT batch_id FROM contoso_meta_dev.audit.audit_gold_publication_group WHERE publication_group_id = 'SALES_MART' AND delivery_id = 'SALES|2026-09-15' AND release_status = 'ACTIVE') SELECT 'failed_load_events' AS metric, CAST(count(*) AS STRING) AS observed, '0' AS expected FROM contoso_meta_dev.audit.v_load_run_status WHERE batch_id = (SELECT batch_id FROM batch) AND run_status = 'FAILED' UNION ALL SELECT 'failed_bronze_events', CAST(count(*) AS STRING), '0' FROM contoso_meta_dev.audit.v_load_run_status WHERE batch_id = (SELECT batch_id FROM batch) AND layer = 'BRONZE' AND run_status = 'FAILED' UNION ALL SELECT 'active_publications', CAST(count(*) AS STRING), '6' FROM contoso_meta_dev.audit.audit_gold_publication WHERE batch_id = (SELECT batch_id FROM batch) AND publication_status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_versions', CAST(count(*) AS STRING), '2000' FROM contoso_vault_dev.raw_vault.sat_customer_h WHERE _batch_id = (SELECT batch_id FROM batch) UNION ALL SELECT 'product_versions', CAST(count(*) AS STRING), '500' FROM contoso_vault_dev.raw_vault.sat_product_h WHERE _batch_id = (SELECT batch_id FROM batch) UNION ALL SELECT 'employee_versions', CAST(count(*) AS STRING), '50' FROM contoso_vault_dev.raw_vault.sat_employee_h WHERE _batch_id = (SELECT batch_id FROM batch) UNION ALL SELECT 'current_delivery_count', CAST(count(DISTINCT _as_of_delivery_id) AS STRING), '1' FROM (SELECT _as_of_delivery_id FROM contoso_gold_dev.current.dim_customer UNION ALL SELECT _as_of_delivery_id FROM contoso_gold_dev.current.dim_product UNION ALL SELECT _as_of_delivery_id FROM contoso_gold_dev.current.dim_employee UNION ALL SELECT _as_of_delivery_id FROM contoso_gold_dev.current.dim_date UNION ALL SELECT _as_of_delivery_id FROM contoso_gold_dev.current.fct_sales UNION ALL SELECT _as_of_delivery_id FROM contoso_gold_dev.current.fct_returns) UNION ALL SELECT 'current_delivery', coalesce(max(_as_of_delivery_id), 'NONE'), 'SALES|2026-09-15' FROM contoso_gold_dev.current.fct_sales
